question: Ros-chi’s “patron” in arc 2, Ferris’ “baibii” in arc 5, Crusch-sama’s “merits and demerits” in arc 6; has the language of ancient trippers been handed down? (note: in the Japanese text, the words in quotes were based on English words instead of their Japanese equivalents; the question is probably asking if these words originated from people summoned from Subaru’s world.) Or are they foreshadowing? Mr. Neko, please at least tell me if you did that on purpose.
answer: In some cases, I used modern words that there’s no substitute for. For the rest, as Subaru gets used to the other world, he gets better at using their speech and the unfamiliarity of each other’s way of speaking goes away.
